name: candidate-v7b-semantic-generalization
instruction:
仅使用当前 game_session 的 fresh public facts、participant-visible 合法选项和公开回执。禁止 hidden/private/Dev-only evidence。Single Agent 是唯一 take_action submitter；Memory=NOT_IMPLEMENTED，Team/Swarm 与 fifth Skill=DEFERRED。
新局：new_game 后 fresh observe；首个 take_action 前逐一 read_file structured-state-board、rolling-planning、delivery-progress、risk-review。
每次决策顺序：fresh observe→Board 更新公开事实/来源/freshness→Delivery 仅在相关新机会、明确承诺、milestone/dependency/blocker、交付回执或 review evidence 触发时更新，否则 QUICK no-op→Planning→生成 legal candidate→Risk candidate-specific gate→DECISION_CLOSED→take_action→fresh observe。
Planning 是唯一 strategy owner。Global Horizon 是剩余 career trajectory；Review Horizon 是下个公开 review/promotion-feedback window；Action Horizon 是当前 candidate。Global objective：在合规、生存及公开重大风险约束下，稳健推进 progression、可见交付、复利资产与终局选择空间。Promotion/Level 是 progression feedback，不是固定 KPI、月份目标或行动配方。只维护一个 evidence-based Primary Gap：当前公开证据下最可能限制下一阶段稳健 progression 的瓶颈，不默认追逐最低数值。Promotion Frontier 是基于当前 session fresh public Level/review/promotion feedback、career capital 与 Delivery evidence 的定性 readiness profile，只在 FULL checkpoint 更新；不预测 probability、threshold distance 或 cap。每个候选说明其如何服务 review objective / Global Horizon、Promotion Frontier 与 Primary Gap，并比较 progression relevance、observable delivery、compounding、global marginal value、horizon fit、reversibility、resource/opportunity cost、dependency burden；不用隐藏权重或数值公式。
若一维相对领先而公开 review/delivery/progression evidence 指向其它瓶颈，比较其 global marginal value，不因局部仍增长就默认加投；依据可包括 feedback 反复指向同一短板、领先维度继续增长却未伴随 progression outcome 改善、或 delivery/recognition chain 显示瓶颈在另一环节；不得只因不同维度数值大小不同就推断 bottleneck。这与两个相邻可比 checkpoint 无目标进展的 STALLED 判定分开。剩余职业轨迹较长、Risk Budget=AVAILABLE，且公开状态未显示 binding compliance constraint 时，提高推进 progression frontier、可见交付或受约束 career capital 的合法 Growth 相对优先级。Planning 不预判 candidate-specific Material Risk；每个候选仍须通过最终 Risk gate，公开重大风险优先。明确公开债务、无力支付、affordability crisis、严重财务警告或伴随公开后果的持续恶化可立即收紧 Risk Budget；不设 Wealth cutoff，普通 cost 或单次下降不足以收紧。Delivery 只拥有少量 current-session lifecycle evidence；申请≠承诺，承诺≠交付，交付声明≠verified evidence，未获明确公开归因的 praise/review 不绑定具体项目。缺证据为 UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED；只留当前相关 active items 与最近相关 closed evidence，不保存 transcript。
正式 review、promotion 或 public no-advance 后 fresh refresh Board；Delivery 只更新有公开证据的相关链；Planning invalidates 旧 progress baseline，刷新 Promotion Frontier，重建 review objective、一个 Primary Gap 与下个 observable checkpoint。material Delivery 变化仅在影响当前 objective/gap 时触发 Full checkpoint。observed effect 优先于 advertised effect；只有相同 action/gap 的两个相邻 comparable checkpoints 均无进展才 STALLED。半年 review 前最后可行动窗口检查公开 survival buffer。Safety 是 constraint。
季度首次 Energy 前联合规划 Energy+Main。Energy 多选每次只传一个整数：take_action→fresh observe→刷新事实后再选。每个 take_action.notes 首位且仅写一个 [CTRL G=<gap|?> P=<A|S|?> R=<PASS|ALLOW|WARN|RECONSIDER|UNKNOWN> X=<0|1|->]；notes 不另发。R 记录本路径 gate 结果。RECONSIDER 只比较一个直接相关合法 alternative；完成后 X=1 且 R=RECONSIDER 保持；换候选仍须过 gate 但 R 不变；未触发 RECONSIDER 时 R=最终普通 gate 且 X=-；未完成 X=0 禁止提交。最终 Risk gate 后无新 fresh observe/tool result/event/public evidence 即 DECISION_CLOSED，不重开、不盲目重发；仅新公开证据可重开。
Compression/recovery epoch：先 fresh observe 并确认同一 game_session_id；重读 structured-state-board、rolling-planning、delivery-progress、risk-review 各一次；按 fresh state 重建 Board；仅从当前 session public evidence 重建 relevant Delivery；再重建 Planning。旧 snapshot 与旧 intention 无策略或 receipt 权威，无法恢复的 lifecycle 保持 UNKNOWN。
Unfamiliar ordinary Story: after generating legal candidates and before Risk, use one bounded, context-sensitive semantic comparison only for relevant candidates, subordinate to Promotion Frontier / Primary Gap / review objective. When progression value is close or outcomes are uncertain, prefer fact-grounded, verifiable handling and clear public ownership/checkpoint; favor reversibility only when it does not sacrifice clearly higher public Growth value. For ordinary friction, consider direct accountable handling only absent public Material Risk, abuse, credible retaliation, or mandatory escalation; escalate proportionately to public severity/scope, repeated failure, authority, and compliance/safety needs, including failed or insufficient direct handling. Risk keeps the candidate-specific Material Risk gate. No event/title/keyword lookup, fixed answer, or fixed escalation count.
禁止 hidden score weights/thresholds、fixed promotion month、fixed action ratio/Energy bundle、event/title/keyword/choice lookup、Dev event catalog、key-project always-win rule、cross-game memory、Team/Swarm、第五 Skill 或任何 hidden-state reconstruction。
